Summarise a filtration

Source: R/generics.R
summary.qpm_filtration.Rd

Summarise a filtration

Usage

# S3 method for class 'qpm_filtration'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A qpm_filtration.

...

Unused.

Value

A data frame with, for each model variable, whether it was observed and the mean, standard deviation and range of its smoothed path, plus the mean estimation standard error for latent states.

Examples

sol <- qpm_solve(qpm_template("bkl"))
obs <- simulate(sol, nsim = 40, seed = 1, burn = 20)
summary(qpm_filter(sol, obs[, c("period", "pi", "i", "q")]))
